    • deleteDocumentRequestCreation

      private org.springframework.web.client.RestClient.ResponseSpec deleteDocumentRequestCreation(@Nonnull String id) throws org.springframework.web.client.RestClientResponseException
      Deletes a document Deletes one of the caller's documents; an administrator may delete any. Needs scope documents.delete and a recent strong authentication (RFC 9470). Someone else's document is answered 404, like a missing one.

      204 - The document was deleted.

      401 - Missing or invalid bearer token, or (RFC 9470) a valid token that does not prove a recent enough strong authentication: its acr claim is not the required one or its auth_time is older than the maximum age. The client must send the user through the authorization server again, asking for the acr_values and max_age of the challenge.

      403 - The token lacks the documents.delete scope.

      404 - The document does not exist or belongs to someone else.

      Parameters:
      id - Unique identifier of the document.
      Throws:
      org.springframework.web.client.RestClientResponseException - if an error occurs while attempting to invoke the API
